entries.title: Model Context Protocol — Transports (2025-06-18)
entries.note: Defines stdio and Streamable HTTP as the two standard MCP transports; clients SHOULD support stdio whenever possible.

entries.title: Model Context Protocol — Ping utility
entries.note: Optional bidirectional JSON-RPC ping for liveness; either party MAY initiate; receiver MUST respond promptly with empty result.

entries.title: modelcontextprotocol/rust-sdk (rmcp) on GitHub
entries.note: Official Rust MCP SDK built on tokio; provides server/client crate features and transports including stdio, child process, SSE, and Streamable HTTP.

entries.title: modelcontextprotocol/inspector on GitHub
entries.note: Two-component (React UI + Node proxy) tool that bridges browser UI to MCP servers via stdio, SSE, or Streamable HTTP.

entries.title: tokio::process::Command — Tokio docs
entries.note: Async child process API; kill_on_drop is false by default; explicit wait()/kill() recommended for predictable cleanup.

entries.title: Spawning — Tokio tutorial
entries.note: Tasks are 'green threads' ~64 bytes each; require 'static + Send.

entries.title: tokio::sync::mpsc — Tokio docs
entries.note: Bounded MPSC channel for backpressure between async tasks; broadcast and watch are sibling primitives.

entries.title: Channels — Tokio tutorial
entries.note: Convention: mpsc for queues, watch for state, broadcast for events.

entries.title: nix crate — Rust friendly bindings to *nix syscalls
entries.note: Modules sys::wait (waitpid), sys::signal (SIGCHLD, sigaction), unistd (fork, exec, setsid); Unix-only.

entries.title: win32job crate on crates.io
entries.note: Rust wrapper around Windows Job Objects; supports KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE so child processes die with parent.

entries.title: process-wrap crate on crates.io
entries.note: Cross-platform child supervision; wraps Tokio Command with Unix process groups and Windows job objects.

entries.title: interprocess crate — local_socket module
entries.note: Cross-platform abstraction: Unix domain sockets on *nix, named pipes on Windows; tokio submodule for async.

entries.title: keyring crate — Rust cross-platform secrets
entries.note: Platform stores: macOS Keychain, Windows Credential Manager, Linux Secret Service / keyutils, Android shared prefs.

entries.title: rusqlite crate docs
entries.note: Synchronous SQLite wrapper; supports bundled SQLite, prepared statements, transactions, blob I/O, hooks; no async, no migrations built-in.

entries.title: Rust ORMs in 2026: Diesel vs SQLx vs SeaORM vs Rusqlite
entries.note: Comparison: SQLx is async multi-backend toolkit; rusqlite is lightweight sync wrapper; sled is non-SQL embedded KV.

entries.title: tracing crate — Rust structured diagnostics
entries.note: Spans + events + Subscriber model; #[instrument] attribute; async-aware; bridges to log and OpenTelemetry.

entries.title: tracing-opentelemetry crate
entries.note: Layer that converts tracing spans into OpenTelemetry spans for export via OTLP.

entries.title: Large Rust Workspaces — matklad
entries.note: Recommends flat crates/ directory, virtual root manifest, crate folder name == crate name.

entries.title: Cargo Workspaces — The Rust Book
entries.note: Canonical reference: shared Cargo.lock, shared target/, workspace.dependencies for version pinning.

entries.title: Docker overview — official docs
entries.note: Docker uses a client-server architecture; client talks to dockerd daemon over REST API (Unix socket or TCP).

entries.title: containers/conmon on GitHub
entries.note: Per-container monitor used by Podman and CRI-O; holds stdio open, captures exit status, writes logs to journal.

entries.title: podman(1) — Podman command reference
entries.note: Daemonless container engine; `alias docker=podman` works for most usage.

entries.title: Deep dive into containers — William Durand
entries.note: Explains containerd + containerd-shim: shim becomes subreaper, keeps stdio open, lets runc exit while container keeps running.

entries.title: systemd — Wikipedia
entries.note: PID 1 init + service supervisor on Linux; uses cgroups to track services; journald for structured logs.

entries.title: Control Group APIs and Delegation — systemd.io
entries.note: Official guide to how systemd manages cgroups and delegates subtrees to services.

entries.title: A launchd Tutorial — launchd.info
entries.note: Reference on launchd: PID 1 on macOS; LaunchAgents (per-user) vs LaunchDaemons (system); plist configuration.

entries.title: launchd — Wikipedia
entries.note: Apple init/service manager; on-demand activation by listening on sockets/ports.

entries.title: Multi-User Mode — Nix Reference Manual
entries.note: Privileged nix-daemon owns the store; unprivileged clients connect via NIX_REMOTE=daemon; builds run as nixbld* users.

entries.title: The State of Async Rust: Runtimes — corrode.dev
entries.note: Ecosystem has consolidated around tokio; async-std discontinued in early 2025; smol survives as small unopinionated runtime.

entries.title: Lima architecture — DeepWiki
entries.note: Four layers: UI CLI, YAML config, host agent (VM orchestration), guest agent + runtimes.

entries.title: uvx: Run Python CLI Tools in Isolated Environments — pydevtools
entries.note: uvx resolves package, creates short-lived environment, executes entry point; cached envs reused until pruned.

entries.title: pipx: Install Python CLI Tools in Isolation — pydevtools
entries.note: Each tool installed into its own venv under PIPX_HOME/venvs; uses pip internally.

entries.title: danieleades/serde-evolve on GitHub
entries.note: Versioned serde representation/domain split using From/TryInto; compile-time migration completeness.

entries.title: tokio-process-tools crate
entries.note: Higher-level Tokio process wrapper with backpressure modes (drop-latest vs block-until-space).

entries.title: Model Context Protocol — Lifecycle (2025-06-18)
entries.note: Initialize / initialized / shutdown phases and version negotiation.
